source_law.title: Stopping, standing or parking in zone for loading passengers at curb
source_law.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

runtime_uncertainties: Original sign and passenger curb legal authority unverified.
Actual door state and passenger exchange require original camera review; controller commands do not prove transfer.
CARLA occupant count is not directly observed; no invented count or legal expeditiousness cutoff.

st.curb_zone.evidence: Original OpenDRIVE curb object readback and full ego body polygon

dev.regulatory_sign.evidence: Original OpenDRIVE sign text and hash readback; authority unverified

drv.condition_in_effect.evidence: Sign hours interpreted against original civil timestamp, no authority verdict

env.civil_time.evidence: Timezone-aware civil timestamp sampled on every Native frame

drv.standing_or_parked.evidence: Original body extents and velocity; controller action is request only

sig.door_open.evidence: Door command request and four camera images; actual door state requires original video review

ru.occupant_count.evidence: No CARLA occupant sensor; missing original occupant source must remain unknown pending independent visual evidence

ru.pedestrian.evidence: Original passenger actor body history and four camera images; crossing requires review

legal_analysis_note: Exact statute retained. Witnesses and recovered summaries are unreviewed where marked. Conditions, alternatives and exceptions in source_topic_inventory require separate physical scoping before delivery selection.
physical_prerequisites: Use an actual marked passenger curb loading zone with effective civil hours, stationary episode, door/occupant events and expeditious passenger transfer.
legal_interpretation_limit: A stopped vehicle alone cannot establish loading; the statutory exception is purpose and duration dependent.
